rationale: Sam's work on tooling and systems for autonomous vehicles at Applied Intuition complements Arvin's focus on autonomous agents and agentic systems at Roam Labs — both are building infrastructure for autonomous decision-making, just in different domains. Arvin's expertise in AI agents and workflow orchestration could inform approaches to vehicle autonomy, while Sam's systems-level thinking on autonomous vehicle development offers practical grounding for scaling multi-agent systems.
intro_message: Sam Morstein, meet Arvin — you're both working on autonomous systems from different angles (vehicles vs. AI agents), and your complementary technical approaches could spark useful ideas.
